## Why visit

One of the most distinctive experiences for travellers who already know Europe’s beer cities. Balance concentrates on mixed-culture beer matured in barrels and also makes spontaneously fermented, barrel-aged cider from pressed apple juice. Visiting the taproom puts that process and its results together in one place, with bottles suitable for sharing. This earns a place through fermentation character and producer access rather than conventional cask breadth. It is an excellent focused addition to the Piccadilly cluster, especially if a cider-club event or tasting fits your exact dates.

## Beer

Wild and sour beers are the core offering, with rotating draught and bottles. CAMRA says cask appears only very occasionally; do not plan on a regular cask range.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** CAMRA explicitly flags real cider; the brewery documents its own spontaneously fermented, barrel-aged cider. Ask what is ready and available, plus guest cider/perry.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).

## Food

CAMRA reports delivered pizza; confirm arrangements. The taproom does not establish a full kitchen.

## Plan the visit

Normally Thursday–Sunday on the current official page. CAMRA reports ticketed Manchester Cider Club meetings, but no November session is assumed confirmed here.

**Getting there:** Walk from Manchester Piccadilly; near Sureshot on Sheffield Street.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
